def extract_pairs(txt):
 out=[]
 for i in (1,2,3):
  pat=rf'Demo pair {i} input \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)\nDemo pair {i} output \(\d+x\d+\):\n(.*?)(?=\n\nSame instance)'
  m=re.search(pat,txt,re.S)
  if not m: continue
  parse=lambda s:[list(map(int,row.split())) for row in s.strip().splitlines()]
  out.append((parse(m.group(1)),parse(m.group(2))))
 return out
pairs=[]
